Any member data inside the workout

start: Member phone, Workout tab, the gym set a workout for today

steps.action: Open the Workout tab (member_gym_wod)
user_sees: Today's workout of the day with its name, exercises, note and who set it
must_not: Yesterday's or tomorrow's workout shown as today's

steps.action: Tap to start it
user_sees: A workout starts with those exercises; the phone keeps its own copy
must_not: The workout lost if the gym takes it off mid-workout

start: Member phone, Workout tab, a member the gym's list cannot match

steps.action: Open the Workout tab with no check-in number, a number on two list members, or a different first name
user_sees: No workout of the day, and the reason in plain words (NO_PHONE, SHARED_NUMBER, NAME_MISMATCH, NOT_ON_ROSTER, GYM_NOT_ONLINE)
must_not: A crash on the error answer

start: Member phone, a workout of the day was set for today

steps.action: The gym takes it off; reopen the Workout tab
user_sees: No workout of the day
must_not: The removed workout still offered as new

steps.action: Open the tab again after 00:00 India time
user_sees: The new day's workout, or none
must_not: Yesterday's workout still shown as today's

steps.action: Look at the workout of the day
user_sees: The gym's routine and the setter's name only
